New York: Audemars Piguet set 506 diamonds into a single cuff for its first-ever jewelry collection.

Royal Oak Joaillerie opened 1 October at Paris Fashion Week, 18 pieces in gold and titanium carrying the Royal Oak's bracelet into jewelry. AP built jewelry watches for Tiffany, Cartier and Bulgari since the 19th century; this is its first collection under its name.

New York: Rio Tinto has handed the Argyle Pink Diamonds brand to Boodles, five years after the mine went quiet.

Argyle was the world's only major source of pink diamonds, over 90% of global supply, before production ended 3 November 2020. Boodles, a 228-year-old British jeweller, now holds the last Argyle inventory and the brand's name.
